page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-4-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. This instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 15.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB per core. For local storage, the server includes a bundled 402 GB NVMe SSD, while no GPUs are present in this configuration.

Benchmark results show strong single-threaded performance, with Geekbench single-core scores and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression placing in the top tier. However, multi-threaded performance is relatively weaker, as evidenced by bottom-quartile results in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory read bandwidth is average, reaching 345.89 GB/sec for small cached blocks, but large block write bandwidth is limited to 23.42 GB/sec.

Given its hardware profile, this server offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads that benefit from fast local storage. The inclusion of a 402 GB NVMe SSD makes it a viable option for database operations, web serving, and text processing tasks that do not require massive multi-core scaling. It is less suitable for heavy multi-threaded compute or large-scale LLM text generation, where its performance falls into the lower percentiles.
